intro.text: A serving maid of House Davar at the family's manor in Jah Keved.

items.text: Around 1170, furious over Jushu's gambling debts and over Shallan questioning his deal with Revilar, Lin Davar took out his rage on Minara. He beat her until one arm was bent the wrong way, and she left blood on the wall as she tried to crawl off.
